CHANGELOG updated in IDUNA_PRO: feat(community-tools): resume/CV builder + verifier, gated by a real per-account feature flag (IsCommunityToolsEnabled -> community-tools.access permission). Real JSON Resume schema-mirrored data model + itemized 2-layer verify (schema conformance + ATS-readiness rules). GET/PUT resume + POST verify, scoped to caller's own local_uid. Live-verified fresh-SQLite boot + migration. 12 new tests, full suite green. Apple #18725. (sess-20260905-0720-ec33e7c5)

⚓ ☃
